method: Read all 781 cues in four consecutive batches of 200, 200, 200 and 181; inspect both outer communicative frames and inner chunks. Prioritize spoken reuse; exclude the user's known basic formulas, isolated unfamiliar words, lyrics and credit lines. Compare with E01–E04 and E07 selections and omit same-use repeats. Quotes join the complete continuous source cues without rewriting; no audio/video checking.
